newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Hero takes over Wing Sung.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Hero takes over Wing Sung.

text.p: Shanghai Hero Co Ltd became the largest shareholder of Wing Sung Co Ltd by buying 27.23 million of its state shares to acquire 28 percent of the firm, Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said that this was the first time in the history of Shanghai's modern stock market that one listed firm had taken over another one by buying its state shares.

Chinese companies issue three kinds of share, one traded in the stock market and two kinds that are not publicly tradeable -- legal person shares held by institutions and state shares held by state organisations.

Shanghai Hero bought the state shares from Shanghai Light Industry Holding Group, whose holding of Wing Sung shares has fallen to 25.6196 million or 26.34 percent, making it the second biggest shareholder, the newspaper said.
Shanghai Hero, which has A and B shares listed on the Shanghai stock exchange, is one of China's largest producers of pens.
In the first half of 1996, it posted unaudited post-tax profits of 31.176 million yuan, up from 28.2 million in the same 1995 period, it said in its interim report.
Wing Sung is also a major manufacturer of pens.
In the first half of 1996, it posted unaudited post-tax profits of 9.496 million yuan, down from 9.981 million yuan, it said in its interim report.
